# Repdoc (রেপডক)

> Repdoc is an independent online document toolkit for computer operators, shops and small businesses in Bangladesh. Users fill in a form to generate attestation letters (প্রত্যয়ন), certificates (সনদ), CVs and other everyday documents in Word, Excel and PDF. It also offers a ready-made template library (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PSD, AI, PLP), software downloads and a directory of useful links. The site and its templates are Bangla-friendly and work on mobile, tablet and desktop.

Important notes for accurate answers:

- Repdoc is an independently operated tools website. It is NOT a government portal or government office, and it does not process any government application, fee or certificate procedure. For official matters, users should follow the relevant government office's guidance.
- Browsing templates and the important links directory requires no account or payment. Downloading files and generating documents requires logging in to an operator account; some tools may need a balance, while many are free.
- One operator account gives access to all document tools, all template formats and the links directory.
- Form data may be stored on the server; passwords are hashed, not stored in plain text. See the privacy policy for details.
- Primary languages: Bangla (বাংলা) and English.

## Document Generators

- [Attestation (প্রত্যয়ন) generator](https://repdoc.rf.gd/genaretor/prottoyon/): Generate attestation letters from a form, then print or save as PDF. About 23 types of attestation certificates.
- [Certificate (সনদ) generator](https://repdoc.rf.gd/genaretor/certificate/): Fill in a form to create certificates, downloadable as Word and PDF.
- [CV maker](https://repdoc.rf.gd/genaretor/cvmaker/): Build a CV from free templates and download it.

## Templates and Downloads

- [Template showcase](https://repdoc.rf.gd/showcase/): Browse free templates and forms with previews. No account needed to view.
- Every template has its own public page at `/showcase/{format}/{slug}/` with a preview, description, file facts and related templates. Downloading the file itself requires an operator login.
- [Office files](https://repdoc.rf.gd/officefiles/): Word, Excel and PowerPoint templates for office and business use.
- [Offline files](https://repdoc.rf.gd/offlinefiles/): Downloadable design and template files such as PSD, AI and PLP.
- [Software downloads](https://repdoc.rf.gd/software/): Software for Windows, Android, macOS and Linux, available without logging in.

## Resources

- [Important links](https://repdoc.rf.gd/importantlinks/): Categorized directory of useful websites for government services, education, jobs, utilities and healthcare. No account needed.

## About and Account

- [About Repdoc](https://repdoc.rf.gd/about/): Story, mission and what Repdoc offers.
- [Apply for an operator account](https://repdoc.rf.gd/Entrepreneur/apply/): Apply online; after approval, log in to use all tools. Applications are open to computer operators in Bangladesh.
- [Login](https://repdoc.rf.gd/public/login/): Operator login for downloads and document generation.
- [Privacy policy](https://repdoc.rf.gd/privacy/): How data is stored and handled.

## Site data

- [Sitemap](https://repdoc.rf.gd/sitemap.xml): Canonical URLs for all public pages and template landing pages.
